design_note: Nine definitions were frozen before v3 full-corpus coding. Earlier exploratory analyses and the same-base 120-text blind review have already been seen; neither categories nor specifications are selected by p-values.
population: All 9,532 posts remain in source data; semantic models use posts with a readable cleaned body and a known value for the individual v3 label.
model: One separate OLS model per eligible label, outcome ln(1+likes), text length and recorded metadata controls, author/date fixed effects, author-clustered SE with finite-sample correction.
eligibility: At least 40 positive and 40 negative posts and at least 10 authors with within-author variation. Rare labels are described even if not estimable. Label eligibility is not based on outcomes or p-values.
multiple_testing: BH correction across all eligible v3 labels separately for each model specification. This does not control for previous classification variants or the overall research search.
robustness: remove top 1% likes within the label-specific eligible sample
retain authors with at least 10 eligible posts
collinearity: On posts complete for all nine labels, include all supported v3 labels jointly with author/date fixed effects and prior controls. Report rank, pairwise phi, cooccurrence and VIF. This diagnostic is not the separately fitted main models.
validation: The same-base AI double coding of 120 distinct texts is an exploratory agreement check, not human accuracy; low-support labels and excluded unknowns are disclosed. The coding manual and schema were frozen before sampling the review set.
limits: Original bodies, annotations and mappings remain private. Neither AI-derived category labels nor observational relationships establish true psychological states or causal effects.
